description:
Migrate the triangular base-case crossover to resolve-once reads at the nine public entries.

## Background

The proof-surface seam design (dev/active/7d7c647c/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §3 fixes the three-part seam with probe-verified surface claims, §4 gives each field its name, kind, range, default-naming constant, mechanism and route-observation obligation, §5 records the decisions (D1 direct removal, D2 lane split, D3 opaque pin, D4 default naming, D5 public reporters, D6 source-level convention amendments), §6 enumerates the post-processing deletions, and §8 scopes the tasks. The follow-on migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) supplies the shared field-kind, mechanism and test conventions.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each of the seven *_inner drivers takes the resolved threshold by parameter, each of the nine public entries resolves triangular.base_case_max_dim exactly once, and tuning::active() never appears inside a recursion.
- [hard] REQ-02: triangular_route is public and called by the dispatchers; installed-profile route files on both sides of the boundary for one trsm, one trmm and one trtri entry pass.
- [hard] REQ-03: The module dispatch tables the seam design §8 U6 names are rewritten to name the profile field; behaviour with no profile installed is unchanged.
title: Cut the triangular base-case threshold over to the tuning profile
